name: A match URL listed in sitemap.xml renders real match content when visited
description: When a visitor opens /sitemap.xml, extracts a match URL from it, then visits that URL, the destination is a real match detail page — proving sitemap entries are not stale links or 404 traps.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /sitemap.xml on the target host
Read the first URL whose path begins with /match/ from the sitemap
Navigate to that match URL on the same target host (do not change hostnames)
Verify the destination page is not a 404 view (no 404 indicator or not-found message visible)
Verify the destination page surfaces match-detail content — a kickoff time, venue, team name, or stage label
